context:
Goal: drop the pick guard's false alarm for a cloud session whose page writer is another session (#2489), without opening a hole.
Problem (rule): #2489's round 3 found negative net value, so decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 parks it until you decide. It opens one class: a same-turn send to the session named in the `page-writer` key passes with no page read, where main refuses. Mistake forms: a stale key after a writer rotation (no rotation step writes the key), and a send that errored still counts.
Based on (measured): round 3 review record 6762140862 on #2489; no repo sets the key today, so live harm is near zero.
Departs from: main — #2489 would ship with one more fix, past its three rounds.
Meanwhile: #2489 stays parked and its lane waits.

options.gain: The false alarm goes, and the net value turns non-negative.
options.how: A send whose result errored no longer counts. A red case first, a Sonnet builder, then a Sonnet fix check and the net-value test.
options.label: Allow one fix pass (Recommended)
options.lose: One more review cycle past the cap.

ref: PR #2489; review record 6762140862 on #2489; decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3; step pick-guard-cloud-writer-mutants
reply: Routed 09:07 CST Nov 10 to the coordinator: pick a, one fix pass for #2489. Home: decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3.
title: Let a parked PR (#2489) get one fix pass past its three review rounds?
why: Decides whether the pick guard's false alarm for a cloud session with another page writer goes now; a held PR gets no fix lane until you decide.
